Five-card draw it is. You start with 1,000 chips, and each of us antes 10, so the pot is 20. We each get five cards face down, then there's a round of betting. After that, each of us can swap up to three cards, or four if you're keeping an Ace. One more round of betting, then we show hands, and a tie splits the pot.

Here's your hand: a pair of kings. Your move: check, bet 20 or fold.
